NPCNamePortrait.Title: NPC — Name & Portrait Creator
NPCNamePortrait.SourceIntro: Use images from your computer or link a folder already available to Foundry.
NPCNamePortrait.PickFolderHint: Select a folder on your computer. Only image files are used. Each image becomes a new actor cloned from the template.
NPCNamePortrait.PickFolderCompact: Select a local folder. Non-image files are skipped automatically.
NPCNamePortrait.DirectoryLinkHint: Paste an assets.jinx.gg / play.jinx.gg URL or a Data path (e.g. Assets/TokenRings/…). All images in that folder (and subfolders) are listed — no re-upload.
NPCNamePortrait.DirectoryLinkCompact: Paste an assets URL or browse a Foundry folder. Images stay in place.
NPCNamePortrait.BadDirectoryLink: Enter a valid folder URL or Data path.
NPCNamePortrait.ReadyDescription: Confirm the template and portraits below, then create the actors.
NPCNamePortrait.ImportDoneDescription: Your mass duplicates have been created and added to the Actors directory.
NPCNamePortrait.NoImages: No image files found in that folder.
NPCNamePortrait.Partial: Created {ok} actor(s); {fail} failed. Check the console for details.
NPCNamePortrait.NeedGM: Only a Gamemaster can create mass duplicates.
NPCNamePortrait.NeedPermission: You do not have permission to create actors.
NPCNamePortrait.EmptyList: Pick a local folder or load a Foundry directory first.
